description: List every DDS endpoint (writer and reader) announced on the bus as an `EndpointListing`; one `EndpointInfo` each with `role`, `dds_topic` (raw, e.g. `rt/scan`), `ros_topic` (`/scan`; `null` with `ros_topic_note` for a non-ROS topic), `type_name`, `type_id`, the owning `participant_guid` with `participant_name`, and a structured `qos`. Use it instead of parsing `peek_dds_samples` and joining GUID prefixes. **Large buses**: pass `fields` `compact` to replace each `qos` by a one-line `qos_summary` and drop `type_id`, `announced_ns` and `ros_topic_note`; the default `full` is verbose, so scope with `topic` or `participant_guid` to read one topic's full QoS. **Orphans**: `by_topic` rolls endpoints up per topic with `writer_count`, `reader_count`, `orphan` (`no_reader` = a writer nobody subscribes to, `no_writer` = a reader nobody publishes to) and the union of partitions. In `qos`, a duration or policy of `None` is infinite/unset or not announced. Among EXCLUSIVE writers the live one with the highest `ownership_strength` delivers; which one owns an instance is runtime state TopicForge cannot observe. **Departed endpoints**: a leaving participant's endpoints are remembered (last 200, 1 h) and shown in `by_topic` as `departed_writers` / `departed_readers` (listed in `endpoints` only with `include_departed`), so a topic that lost its only writer is explained in one call. **Topic filter**: `rt/scan` and `scan` match each other; a filter matching nothing returns a `note` with the closest topics. **This lists discovery facts, not data flow**: it cannot tell a silent or hung writer from a healthy one; pair it with `detect_qos_mismatches`. The observer's own endpoints are excluded unless `include_observer`; ROS 2 service and action endpoints (`rq/`, `rr/`, `rs/`, `rp/`, `ra/`, `ros_discovery_info`) unless `include_internal`. Capped at 500 endpoints (`truncated`, `total`); `by_topic` covers all matches. Read-only. **Raises an MCP error** when no DDS module is active; mock returns a fixture. **Duration**: DDS binding behind the DDS lock, one call at a time; ends within 45 s; `busy` error if the lock is held (retry).

domain_id.description: Ignored: it does not switch domains and is only range-checked (0..232). The domain observed is the one joined at startup (`TOPICFORGE_DDS_DOMAIN_ID`), reported in the response `domain_id`; `note` flags a different non-zero value.

fields.description: `full` (default) or `compact`: one-line `qos_summary` instead of the full `qos`, no `type_id`, `announced_ns` or `ros_topic_note`. Use `compact` on large buses.

include_departed.description: Also list endpoints whose participant left (flagged with `gone_ns`); `by_topic` reports them either way. Default false.

include_internal.description: Also list ROS 2 service and action endpoints (`rq/`, `rr/`, `rs/`, `rp/`, `ra/`, `ros_discovery_info`), most of a small robot's endpoints. Default false.

include_observer.description: Include TopicForge's own observer endpoints. Default false.

participant_guid.description: Only endpoints of this participant (a guid from `list_participants`). Omit for all.

topic.description: Only endpoints on this DDS topic: `scan` or `rt/scan` (exact name first, then the alternate form). Omit for every topic.

name: list_endpoints

gone_ns.description: When the participant was lost, ns since epoch (upper bound).

announced_ns.description: Source timestamp of the announcement, on the announcer's clock; `None` if unavailable.

gone_ns.description: `None` for a live endpoint; for a departed one (`include_departed`) when its participant was lost (upper bound).

is_observer.description: True when the endpoint belongs to TopicForge's own observer participant.

qos.description: Announced QoS; `None` when reliability or durability could not be resolved. A duration of `None` is infinite or unset.

qos_summary.description: One-line QoS, set only with `fields` `compact` (where `qos` is `None`).

role.description: `writer` publishes the topic; `reader` subscribes to it.

ros_topic.description: ROS 2 name of the topic, for example `/scan`. `None` when the endpoint is not a ROS 2 topic: see `ros_topic_note`.

ros_topic_note.description: Why `ros_topic` is `None`. `None` when it is set.

type_id.description: Compact XTypes type identifier (`COMPLETE:<hex>`), `None` when not announced.

data_representation.description: `XCDR1` / `XCDR2` accepted or offered; `None` when not announced.

deadline_ns.description: Deadline in ns; `None` is infinite. A reader deadline shorter than the writer's is incompatible.

durability.description: `VOLATILE` keeps nothing for late joiners, `TRANSIENT_LOCAL` does; a TRANSIENT_LOCAL reader cannot match a VOLATILE writer.

history.description: `KEEP_LAST` (ring of `history_depth`) or `KEEP_ALL`; `None` when discovery did not announce it (see `history_note`).

latency_budget_ns.description: LatencyBudget in ns (a hint); `0` is the default, `None` is infinite or not announced.

liveliness_kind.description: `AUTOMATIC`, or `MANUAL_*` (the app must assert liveliness within `liveliness_lease_ns`); `None` when not announced.

liveliness_lease_ns.description: Liveliness lease in ns; `None` is infinite or not announced.

ownership_kind.description: With `EXCLUSIVE` only the writer with the highest `ownership_strength` delivers; `None` when not announced.

ownership_strength.description: Writer strength under `EXCLUSIVE` ownership; `None` when not announced.

partitions.description: Partition names; the default partition is `[""]`, never `[]`. Endpoints match only if partitions intersect; `None` when unreadable.

reliability.description: `RELIABLE` retries lost samples, `BEST_EFFORT` does not; a RELIABLE reader cannot match a BEST_EFFORT writer.

unknown_policies.description: Policies announced but unreadable (e.g. `Deadline`): their fields are `None`, which does NOT mean infinite; the scan does not compare them.

departed_readers.description: Readers whose participant left, newest first.

departed_writers.description: Writers whose participant left, newest first (last 200, 1 h).

partitions.description: Union of the endpoints' partitions, sorted. `""` is the default partition.

ros_topic.description: ROS 2 name of the topic, for example `/scan`. `None` for a DDS topic that is not a ROS 2 topic.

departed_endpoint_count.description: Departed endpoints matching the filters; listed in `endpoints` only with `include_departed`.

excluded_observer_endpoint_count.description: TopicForge's own endpoints left out of `endpoints` (counted in `total`).

fields.description: Detail level served: `compact` drops per-endpoint QoS detail, type id and notes.

hidden_internal_endpoint_count.description: Service/action endpoints (`rq/`, `rr/`, `rs/`, `rp/`, `ra/`, `ros_discovery_info`) left out while `include_internal` is false.

hints.description: Facts true of every endpoint, stated once (e.g. liveness is not observed).

note.description: Set when a `topic` filter matched nothing: the closest known topics.

observer_guid.description: GUID of TopicForge's own participant, `None` in mock.

snapshot_ns.description: Wall-clock time of the snapshot, ns since epoch.

total.description: Endpoints in the discovery cache before any filter.

truncated.description: True when matching endpoints exceeded the cap.

title: List DDS endpoints
